assumptions: One Slurm node on a shared partition
A deliberately bounded readiness deadline (READINESS_TIMEOUT=1) is configured to force the timeout path before the coordinator can publish its endpoint
limitations: This is a controlled failure run produced by setting READINESS_TIMEOUT below the coordinator startup time; it validates the readiness-timeout failure path, not a spontaneous cluster failure
The coordinator was terminated before publishing endpoint.json, so readiness.log is absent and coordinator.log is empty by construction
This failure run tests readiness-timeout handling only; it does not exercise worker, verification, or cleanup failure paths
portabilityBoundaries: Scheduler accounting and timeout-state presentation vary by site
The FAILED terminal state and exit code 75 reflect this workflow's deliberate BSSW-READY-TIMEOUT diagnostic, not a Slurm infrastructure fault
